name: South Bay Christian Alliance - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: I’m a FTM, and for Mother’s Day, I decided to attend and check out South Bay Christian Alliance Church alongside my friend and her son — she’s also a FTM like me. Before coming to this church, I had been longing to find a church family, and I truly felt like God was leading me here. Everyone was so welcoming from the moment we arrived.
